summary: docs(root): point the root help at skills/fiken/SKILL.md
reason: The printed root help said "See README.md or the bundled SKILL.md for recipes", which was true of a print that dropped a single SKILL.md at the CLI root. This tree now installs every skill under skills/<name>/SKILL.md (commit 71feae7 moved the fiken skill to skills/fiken/SKILL.md, and scripts/check-boundaries.sh's doc-claims check already reads it from there), so "the bundled SKILL.md" named a file that does not exist and the first thing a new agent is told to read was a dead end. One string, no behaviour. A reprint that restores the old wording should collide with this record.
call_sites: See README.md or skills/fiken/SKILL.md for recipes.
validated_outcome: make check green (go vet ./..., go test ./..., scripts/check-boundaries.sh). The file skills/fiken/SKILL.md exists in this tree. No behaviour change and no API call.
